tool.name: T5
tool.summary: Text-To-Text Transfer Transformer — Google's unified framework that converts every NLP task into a text-to-text format, incorporating an architecture of encoder-decoder transformer trained with a span-corruption pre-training objective. The model demonstrates competitive performance across verified evaluations, including SuperGLUE: 88.9 (11B), GLUE: 90.3 (11B). With its Small (60M) to 11B params design, it supports diverse local and enterprise deployment profiles under the Apache-2.0 license.
tool.architecture: Encoder-decoder transformer trained with a span-corruption pre-training objective.
tool.usage:
from transformers import T5Tokenizer, T5ForConditionalGeneration
tokenizer = T5Tokenizer.from_pretrained("t5-base")
model = T5ForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained("t5-base")
input_ids = tokenizer("translate English to French: Hello world", return_tensors="pt").input_ids
tool.limitations: Encoder-decoder architecture slower than decoder-only for generation tasks.
